nodes.content: Design a distributed query-result cache preserving transaction snapshot semantics across concurrent writes, range predicates, and replica lag.
requirements: Every cached result must match uncached execution at the transaction’s snapshot, including during failover.
Reduce p95 read latency 30% versus uncached execution at 80% reads and 20% writes.

nodes.content: Cache snapshot-tagged results; for newer snapshots, validate row and predicate-range dependencies against a durable commit index; bypass lagging replicas.
What durable commit-index watermark guarantees complete row and range validation when a lagging replica is promoted?
A promoted replica replaying the quorum-durable contiguous commit index through the target snapshot detects all intervening row and range writes.
Derive per-shard quorum watermarks, inject failovers in FailoverRange-1, and bypass cache until row/range validation reaches snapshot components.
Run FailoverRange-1 with 10,000 mixed row updates, range inserts, and promotions; compare watermark-validated cache hits against snapshot-pinned execution.
FailoverRange-1 yielded zero mismatches across 8,240 validated hits against snapshot-pinned execution; incomplete-watermark lookups bypassed cache.
Adopt per-shard contiguous quorum watermarks for cache validation; bypass until replay reaches the snapshot, given zero FailoverRange-1 mismatches.
Implement watermark-gated row and range validation, then benchmark ReadMix-80/20 for 30% lower p95 with zero snapshot mismatches.
Implement CacheGuard v1: validate row keys and predicate intervals against quorum-complete intervening commits; bypass on lag or gaps.
CacheGuard v1 adds snapshot-tagged entries, row and predicate-range commit checks, and fail-closed watermark gating across replica promotion.
Rerun FailoverRange-1 on CacheGuard v1 with promotion-time watermark gaps; verify bypasses and compare returned rows against snapshot-pinned execution.
CacheGuard v1 had zero snapshot mismatches across 10,000 FailoverRange-1 operations; all 1,120 promotion-gap lookups bypassed caching.
Can CacheGuard v1 reduce ReadMix-80/20 p95 latency by 30% after validation and replica-lag bypass costs?
Benchmark CacheGuard v1 against uncached ReadMix-80/20 for 30 minutes, recording read p95, cache-hit rate, and lag bypasses.
ReadMix-80/20 read p95 improved only 12% (50→44 ms), below the 30% target; lag bypasses affected 18% of reads.
Decouple cache-hit validation from replica replay using a quorum-sourced commit index; serve hits only after snapshot-complete row/range checks.
Can quorum-sourced validation recover the 18% lag-bypassed reads while preserving snapshot correctness during promotion?
Snapshot-complete quorum validation should recover ≥15 of 18 lag-bypass percentage points as cache hits without promotion mismatches.
Extend CacheGuard v1 with quorum-index validation; rerun ReadMix-80/20 under lag and promotions, measuring recovered hits and snapshot mismatches.
ReadMix-80/20 recovered only 9 of 18 lag-bypass percentage points; zero snapshot mismatches across 10,000 promotion-time reads.
Keep quorum validation for correctness, but reject it as the sole latency fix: it recovers only half the lag-bypassed reads.
Prefetching quorum-committed index segments should recover ≥15 lag-bypass percentage points as validated hits, with zero promotion mismatches.
Implement quorum-index segment prefetch; A/B ReadMix-80/20 against non-prefetched validation, measuring recovered lag-bypass points, read p95, and promotion mismatches.
Prefetch recovered 16 of 18 lag-bypass percentage points; ReadMix-80/20 p95 fell 50→34 ms, with zero mismatches across 10,000 promotion reads.
Implement prefetched quorum validation with fail-closed snapshot gating in CacheGuard v2; canary ReadMix-80/20 p95 and FailoverRange-1 snapshot equality.
Implement CacheGuard v2 with prefetched quorum-committed index segments, per-shard snapshot-completeness checks, and fail-closed promotion gating.
CacheGuard v2 contains quorum-index segment prefetch, snapshot-complete row/range validation, and cache bypass on uncovered shards or promotion gaps.
Eagerly propagate commit-time row and predicate-range invalidations into an MVCC result cache, fencing hits by durable promotion-safe watermarks.
Implement durable, commit-ordered row/range invalidations with MVCC entries; test promotion snapshot equality and ReadMix-80/20 read p95 ≤35 ms.
Extend CacheGuard v1 with commit-ordered row/range invalidation logs and MVCC result versions; fence hits behind quorum-durable promotion watermarks.
EagerInvalidate prototype adds durable row/range invalidation logs, MVCC result versions, and quorum-watermark promotion fences to CacheGuard v1.
A/B EagerInvalidate against CacheGuard v2 on ReadMix-80/20 and FailoverRange-1; measure read p95, invalidation backlog, and snapshot mismatches.
EagerInvalidate cut ReadMix-80/20 p95 to 31 ms versus 34 ms for CacheGuard v2; FailoverRange-1 recorded zero snapshot mismatches.
Select EagerInvalidate over CacheGuard v2 for rollout: 31 versus 34 ms read p95, with zero observed snapshot mismatches.
ReadMix-80/20 A/B report records EagerInvalidate read p95 at 31 ms versus CacheGuard v2 at 34 ms and zero FailoverRange-1 mismatches.
Extend the A/B report: stress CacheGuard v2 and EagerInvalidate under 500 ms lag and promotions; compare p95 and snapshot equality.
At 500 ms lag, CacheGuard v2 p95 rose to 39 ms versus EagerInvalidate’s 33 ms; both had zero snapshot mismatches.
Can a crash between commit durability and invalidation publication expose stale range results after replica promotion?
Using n32’s zero-mismatch baseline, crash EagerInvalidate after durable range inserts but before invalidation publication; compare promoted-replica hits against snapshot execution.
Crash-injection found 7 stale range hits in 10,000 promotion reads: quorum watermark advanced before invalidation publication.
Suspend EagerInvalidate rollout despite 31–33 ms p95: seven stale hits violate snapshots; lagged CacheGuard v2 reaches 39 ms.
Persist invalidations atomically with commits; fence hits until contiguous invalidations replay, then rerun crash-injection and ReadMix-80/20.
Patch EagerInvalidate to embed row/range invalidations in quorum-durable commit records; advance cache-hit fences only after contiguous invalidation replay.
EagerInvalidate v2 replaces separate publication with commit-embedded row/range invalidations and fences cache hits on contiguous replay.
Cache immutable query-result versions over snapshot-validity intervals derived from quorum-durable row/range write sets; require complete shard coverage before hits.
Can quorum-derived validity intervals eliminate promotion-time stale range hits without making ReadMix-80/20 read p95 exceed 35 ms?
Intersecting per-shard quorum-confirmed validity intervals should yield zero stale promotion hits and ReadMix-80/20 read p95 ≤35 ms.
Intersect per-shard validity intervals from EagerInvalidate v2 commit records; rerun crash-injection and ReadMix-80/20, recording stale hits and p95.
Interval prototype recorded zero stale hits across 20,000 promotion reads; ReadMix-80/20 read p95 was 33 ms.
Ship interval-gated cache only after failover fuzzing confirms zero mismatches and ReadMix-80/20 p95 remains ≤35 ms.
Implement immutable result versions with per-shard validity intervals derived from EagerInvalidate v2 commit records; reject hits lacking snapshot coverage.
IntervalCache v1 stores immutable result versions, per-shard quorum-confirmed validity intervals, and fail-closed snapshot-coverage checks.
Fuzz IntervalCache v1 with 100,000 concurrent inserts, deletes, snapshot reads, and promotions; compare hits to uncached snapshot execution.
IntervalCache v1 returned zero mismatches across 100,000 fuzzed operations; 12,400 promotion-gap reads bypassed caching.
Cache snapshot-versioned query fragments per shard, recomposing results only from quorum-certified versions to avoid whole-result invalidation.
Will shard-fragment recomposition cut promotion-gap cache bypasses without raising ReadMix-80/20 p95 above 35 ms?
Reusing quorum-certified shard fragments should halve IntervalCache v1’s 12,400 promotion-gap bypasses while keeping read p95 ≤35 ms.
Prototype shard-fragment recomposition atop IntervalCache v1; replay promotion fuzz and ReadMix-80/20, measuring bypasses, p95, and snapshot mismatches.
Fragment prototype logged 8,100 promotion-gap bypasses versus 12,400, with 38 ms read p95 and zero snapshot mismatches.
Prefetching quorum-certified shard fragments and precomputing merge plans should reduce bypasses below 6,200 and ReadMix-80/20 p95 to ≤35 ms.
Add quorum-certified fragment prefetch and precomputed merge plans to IntervalCache v1; rerun promotion fuzz and ReadMix-80/20, tracking bypasses, p95, mismatches.
Prefetched fragments cut promotion-gap bypasses to 5,900 versus 12,400; ReadMix-80/20 p95 reached 34 ms, with zero snapshot mismatches.
Select prefetched fragments atop IntervalCache over unsafe EagerInvalidate and 38-ms naïve recomposition: 5,900 versus 12,400 bypasses, 34-ms p95, zero mismatches.
Canary prefetched-fragment IntervalCache; require quorum-covered cache hits, zero failover snapshot mismatches, and ReadMix-80/20 p95 ≤35 ms.
Canary prefetched-fragment IntervalCache v1 on 5% of ReadMix-80/20 traffic; compare promotion-time results with uncached snapshots and record read p95.
Canary-5 report records prefetched-fragment IntervalCache’s read p95, quorum-coverage bypasses, and promotion snapshot comparisons against uncached execution.
Audit Canary-5’s promotion snapshot comparisons and bypasses; check read p95 against the 35 ms gate for prefetched fragments.
Canary-5 read p95 was 34 ms versus 50 ms uncached, with zero mismatches across 50,000 snapshot comparisons.
Expand prefetched-fragment IntervalCache beyond 5% canary: 34 ms p95 beats the 35 ms gate, with zero observed snapshot mismatches.
